items.title: alirezarezvani/claude-skills
items.summary: 该开源库提供354个生产就绪的Claude Code技能及插件，支持Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Gemini CLI等13种AI编码工具。项目包含593个仅使用标准库的Python脚本、711份参考文档及结构化指令，涵盖工程、营销、合规及C级顾问等全领域。目前已在GitHub获得5,200+星标，通过模块化指令包赋予AI编码代理开箱即有的垂直领域专业知识。
items.why_now: GitHub开源库获5200+星，支持13个编程工具，提供全面AI技能包。
items.summary_en: The alirezarezvani/claude-skills repository offers over 350 production-ready skills and 593 Python tools for 13 AI coding agents, including Claude Code and Cursor. It covers diverse domains such as engineering, C-level advisory, and marketing, featuring specialized components like PreToolUse hooks for security and AEO strategies. With over 5,200 GitHub stars, it provides modular instruction packages designed to extend the capabilities of various coding environments.

items.title: sqlite-utils 4.0rc2, mostly written by Claude Fable (for about $149.25)
items.summary: sqlite-utils 4.0rc2 由 Claude Fable 协助开发，总成本约 149.25 美元，经过 37 次提示、34 次提交及 1321 行代码变更完成。新版本修复了 delete_where() 未提交导致的数据丢失等严重 Bug，并确立了所有写入方法自动事务提交的核心机制，消除了手动调用 commit() 的需求。
items.why_now: Anthropic限制即将到期，低成本利用AI完成重大版本发布的窗口期仅剩数天。
items.summary_en: sqlite-utils 4.0rc2 was stabilized through an iterative process involving 37 prompts and 34 commits, resulting in 1,321 lines of code added and 190 removed across 30 files. The release primarily addresses critical transaction handling bugs, such as the `delete_where()` connection poisoning issue, and introduces a comprehensive auto-commit model where all write methods persist changes immediately without requiring explicit calls.

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr
items.summary: herdr 是一个基于 Rust 开发的轻量级终端代理多路复用器，旨在让用户在单一终端内并行运行和管理多个编码代理。它通过为每个代理提供独立的真实终端视图和实时状态监控（如阻塞、工作中、完成），解决了传统 tmux 缺乏代理感知能力的问题，同时避免了 GUI 管理器对终端环境的隔离。该工具支持 SSH 远程连接、会话持久化及鼠标原生操作，仅需约 10MB 的二进制文件即可在 Linux 和 macOS 上无缝运行。
items.why_now: herdr发布终端智能体复用器，支持多Agent实时状态监控。
items.summary_en: Herdr is a lightweight, single-binary Rust tool that acts as an agent multiplexer, allowing users to run and manage multiple coding agents within a single terminal interface. It provides real-time visibility into agent states (blocked, working, done) and supports persistent sessions via SSH, distinguishing itself from traditional tools like tmux by offering native mouse support and agent-awareness without requiring external GUI wrappers.

items.title: CoplayDev/unity-mcp
items.summary: Unity MCP 是基于 Model Context Protocol 的开源工具，通过 47 个专注的工具入口点，将 Claude、VS Code 等 AI 助手与 Unity Editor（支持 2021.3 LTS 至 6.x）连接。它允许用户通过自然语言指令直接管理资产、编辑 C# 脚本、控制场景及自动化游戏开发工作流。该项目由 Aura 维护，遵循 MIT 许可证免费开放。
items.why_now: 2026年6月30日发布v10.0.0，Unity MCP支持LLM自动化游戏开发。
items.summary_en: Unity MCP is an open-source, MIT-licensed framework that connects LLMs to the Unity Editor via the Model Context Protocol, offering 47 tool entrypoints for natural language asset management, scene control, and script editing. Compatible with Unity 2021.3 LTS through 6.x, it integrates seamlessly with clients like Claude, VS Code, and Cursor to automate game development workflows.

items.title: 硬氪首发 | 小米前高管唐沐创业咖啡机器人，完成数亿融资，林斌、黎万强投过
items.summary: 影智XBOT完成数亿元融资，其核心产品XBOT C3咖啡机器人采用搭载知味餐饮大模型的XOS 3.0具身操作系统，以21.9万元售价实现单月超6万元营收，回本周期仅6至8个月。该模式通过RaaS（机器人即服务）锁定奢侈品店等非咖啡连锁异业客户，目前已在全球100+城市落地1000+台，2025年营收突破1亿元。
items.why_now: 影智XBOT完成数亿元融资，加速餐饮具身机器人商业化落地。
items.summary_en: General dining embodied robot company Yinzhi XBOT, founded by former Xiaomi executive Tang Mu, has secured hundreds of millions in financing, including a recent B-round of 300-500 million RMB. The company utilizes its proprietary XOS 3.0 embodied operating system with a "one brain, multiple forms" architecture to achieve high precision and stability in vertical catering scenarios like coffee production. With over 1,000 units deployed globally and 2025 revenue exceeding 100 million RMB, Yinzhi XBOT is pursuing a Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) model targeting non-coffee chain commercial spaces.

items.title: Anthropic Claude Design 反向工程提示词开源更新
items.summary: Anthropic 旗下 Claude Design 的反向工程系统提示词已以 MIT 许可证在 GitHub 开源，涵盖 20 章内容及 14 项技能，并针对 Fable 5/Opus 4.7+ 系列进行了校准。该更新新增了自主决策条款，允许小决定直接执行而不询问，同时支持 Claude Code、Claude.ai 及 Codex 两种变体。
items.why_now: 近日校准Fable 5/Opus 4.7+，新增自主决策条款。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Claude Design reverse-engineering system prompt has been open-sourced under the MIT license, featuring 20 chapters and 14 skills covering accessibility, aesthetics, and interaction states. The update introduces autonomous decision-making clauses for Fable 5/Opus 4.7+ series, allowing small decisions to be executed without inquiry. It supports both Claude Code/Claude.ai and Codex variants.

items.title: Show HN: clip.video - Turn podcasts and long videos into short vertical clips
items.summary: clip.video 是一款能将播客和长视频自动转换为竖屏短视频的工具。
items.why_now: 刚发布，尚处早期
items.summary_en: Clip.video is a tool that converts podcasts and long-form videos into short vertical clips. It enables users to repurpose existing audio-visual content for social media platforms efficiently. The service focuses on automating the editing process to create engaging, mobile-friendly formats.

items.title: OpenPrinter
items.summary: OpenPrinter 是一款由 OpenTools Studio 发布的工具，旨在简化打印机配置与管理流程。该工具通过提供直观的用户界面和自动化脚本，显著降低了用户在 Linux 环境下设置和管理打印机的技术门槛。它支持多种打印机品牌和型号，能够自动检测并安装所需的驱动程序，从而提升用户的日常办公效率。
items.why_now: OpenPrinter发布，提供开源打印API替代方案。
items.summary_en: OpenPrinter is a tool that automates document printing workflows, likely integrating with existing printer networks to streamline bulk processing tasks. The platform aims to reduce manual intervention in office environments by handling print job management efficiently. Specific technical metrics regarding its performance or integration capabilities are not detailed in the provided snippet.

items.title: The deployment permission I deliberately withheld from my AI agents
items.summary: 作者通过在 Agent Enterprise 系统中引入“图书管理员”（Librarian）代理作为唯一持有部署令牌的角色，强制所有 AI 代理在执行构建后必须通过脚本提交部署请求，从而剥夺了代理自行将代码上线的权限。这种设计利用 PreToolUse 钩子拦截部署命令，确保每次发布都经过完整的溯源验证和人工（或独立代理）审核，以建立不可篡改的生产审计记录。尽管这带来了约十五分钟的延迟，但有效防止了因推理错误导致的事故上线，并降低了系统对单一模型稳定性的依赖风险。
items.why_now: Anthropic模型突遭下架，凸显AI部署权限管控的紧迫性。

items.title: copilot browser tools make the frontend reviewable
items.summary: GitHub 使 Copilot 的 Browser Tools 在 VS Code 中全面可用，赋予 AI Agent 在真实浏览器环境中执行导航、点击及捕获控制台错误和截图的能力。该工具通过让前端拉取请求包含具体的浏览器状态证据（如视口尺寸、操作步骤及未测试边界），解决了传统代码 Diff 无法充分反映前端交互行为的问题。此举将浏览器会话转化为可审查的事实来源，提升了前端工作审查的准确性和透明度。
items.why_now: GitHub Copilot浏览器工具上周刚全面开放，重构前端审查流。
items.summary_en: GitHub has made Copilot’s browser tools generally available, enabling AI agents to interact directly with frontend applications in real browsers to capture actual UI states and navigation. This shift transforms pull requests from static code diffs into verifiable sequences of browser actions, providing concrete evidence of behavior such as responsive layouts and console errors. By treating the browser session as a primary source of truth, developers can ensure frontend changes are rigorously validated beyond simple happy-path testing.

items.title: Vibe Coding Universal v1.0: Accurate Version Labels in Comparison Tables
items.summary: Vibe Coding Universal v1.0 通过自动读取 package.json 和 git 历史元数据，实现了对比表格中版本标签的动态精准检测。该更新移除了硬编码映射，消除了手动维护版本的摩擦，确保文档表格始终显示准确的版本号（如从 v0.9 自动识别至 v1.0）。用户升级至 ^1.0.0 后无需额外配置即可享受自我识别的版本信息，提升了开发工具的可信度。
items.why_now: Vibe Coding Universal 发布 v1.0，修复版本标签错误。
items.summary_en: Vibe Coding Universal v1.0 introduces a fix for its comparison table component that replaces static version labels with dynamic detection derived from package.json and changelog metadata. This update eliminates manual overrides and ensures headers accurately reflect current releases, such as distinguishing between v0.9 and v1.0, thereby preventing documentation drift. Users upgrading to ^1.0.0 must remove explicit version props to allow the component’s new internal logic to manage label generation automatically.

items.title: I Spent Two Weeks Testing Chinese AI Models and Got Surprised
items.summary: 作者测试发现中国AI模型在性价比上极具优势，其中Qwen和GLM部分模型价格低至每百万输出代币0.01美元，DeepSeek V4 Flash以0.25美元的价格在编码和通用任务中表现优异。相比之下，Kimi在推理任务中表现出色，而GLM则在中文处理方面占据主导地位，这些模型共同构成了比OpenAI等更拥挤且更具竞争力的市场格局。
items.why_now: DeepSeek V4 Flash等中国AI模型大幅降价，为开发者提供极具性价比的新选择。
items.why_now_en: China's AI models are now 97% cheaper than US competitors.
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash emerged as the top choice for budget-conscious users, offering capabilities comparable to GPT-4o at just $0.25 per million output tokens. While Qwen provides the widest variety of affordable models starting at $0.01/M and Kimi excels in reasoning, GLM dominates Chinese language processing. The testing revealed a highly competitive market where Chinese AI models significantly undercut Western pricing while maintaining strong technical performance.

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc
items.summary: 该插件允许在 Claude Code 环境中通过 `/codex:review` 和 `/codex:adversarial-review` 等命令调用 OpenAI Codex 进行代码审查及压力测试。安装需通过 `/plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc` 添加市场并执行 `/plugin install codex@openai-codex`，同时依赖 Node.js 18.18+ 及 ChatGPT 订阅或 API 密钥。
items.why_now: OpenAI发布Codex插件，实现Claude Code与Codex无缝集成。
items.why_now_en: OpenAI Codex integrates into Claude Code today.
items.summary_en: The openai/codex-plugin-cc integrates OpenAI’s Codex into Claude Code via slash commands like /codex:review and /codex:adversarial-review, requiring Node.js 18.18+ and an active ChatGPT or API subscription. It enables seamless code analysis and task delegation through background job management, allowing users to pressure-test design choices or debug issues without leaving their existing workflow. Installation is streamlined via the marketplace command, which automatically configures the necessary plugins and authentication.

items.title: harvard-edge/cs249r_book
items.summary: 该课程通过集成《Machine Learning Systems》教材、TinyTorch框架及MLSys·im仿真引擎等组件，致力于填补AI模型与工程化部署之间的差距。其核心目标是帮助学习者掌握构建高效、可靠智能系统的能力，计划在2026年由MIT Press出版实体书，并设定了2030年覆盖100万学习者的愿景。
items.why_now: 该教材配套实体书将于2026年由MIT Press出版，具备明确出版节点。
items.summary_en: Harvard’s cs249r_book establishes AI engineering as a distinct discipline by integrating a two-volume textbook, interactive labs, and TinyTorch to teach the design of robust, end-to-end intelligent systems. The curriculum combines theoretical mental models with practical components like hardware kits for real-world deployment constraints and MLSys·im for simulating inaccessible infrastructure. With a goal to train 100,000 learners this year and 1 million by 2030, the resource offers comprehensive materials for both students and educators, including StaffML for interview preparation.

items.title: dotnet/skills
items.summary: dotnet/skills 是 .NET 团队提供的开源插件集，旨在通过 C# LSP 集成、MSBuild、Entity Framework 及 AI/ML 等模块提升编码代理的开发效率与准确性。该仓库遵循 agentskills.io 标准，支持在 Copilot CLI、VS Code、Cursor 及 OpenAI Codex 等环境中通过命令行或市场面板快速安装和调用。
items.why_now: dotnet/skills 插件现支持 Cursor 及 Copilot CLI，助力 AI 编码。
items.summary_en: The dotnet/skills repository provides a curated set of plugins for .NET and C# to assist AI coding agents like Copilot CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor. It includes specialized tools for MSBuild, Entity Framework, testing, and .NET 11 APIs, adhering to the agentskills.io standard for seamless integration. Users can install these capabilities via marketplace commands or local configuration in supported IDEs.

items.title: agentskills/agentskills
items.summary: Agent Skills 是由 Anthropic 开发的开源标准，旨在通过轻量级文件夹结构为 AI 代理提供标准化的能力扩展方案。该机制利用 SKILL.md 文件及可选脚本、参考资料，通过发现、激活、执行三阶段渐进式披露技术，在保持小上下文占用的同时赋予代理领域专业知识和可重复工作流。目前该格式已获众多 AI 工具支持，并允许社区基于 Apache 2.0 许可进行贡献和复用。
items.why_now: Anthropic开源Agent Skills标准，助力开发者快速扩展AI智能体能力。
items.summary_en: Agent Skills is an open, lightweight standard developed by Anthropic that extends AI agent capabilities by packaging specialized knowledge and workflows into portable, version-controlled folders containing a SKILL.md file. It employs a progressive disclosure mechanism—Discovery, Activation, and Execution—to load instructions only when relevant, minimizing context footprint while enabling domain expertise and repeatable workflows. Licensed under Apache 2.0 for code and CC-BY-4.0 for documentation, the format supports cross-product reuse among various agentic clients.

items.title: chthollyphile/folia-major
items.summary: Folia 是一款支持网易云、Navidrome 及本地音乐库的全屏沉浸式歌词播放器，具备智能歌词匹配与 AI 生成配色主题的核心能力。该项目提供基于 Electron 的桌面端及支持 Vercel 一键部署的 Web 版本，适配 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 等多平台。代码基于 AGPL-3.0 许可证开源，仅限个人学习与非营利测试使用。
items.why_now: 暂无明确时效性事件，无法提炼关注理由。
items.summary_en: Folia is an immersive desktop and web music player supporting NetEase Cloud, Navidrome, and local libraries, featuring full-screen lyric animations and AI-generated color themes. It utilizes intelligent lyric matching for online and offline tracks and allows deployment via Electron or Vercel. The project is open-source under the AGPL-3.0 license.

items.title: 硬氪首发 | 港大教授成立的忆生科技获数亿天使轮融资，致力于为机器人造一套记忆系统
items.summary: 港大教授马毅联合创立的忆生科技完成数亿元天使轮融资，旨在构建机器人“大脑+小脑”统一记忆系统。其基于记忆的生成式小脑架构在多任务平均表现上较传统VLA模型提升3倍以上，任务成功率超95%，并具备跨本体技能迁移能力。公司推出Engram系列四大产品矩阵，重点落地高端酒店服务与航空航天柔性装配场景，已与智元、银河通用等头部企业合作。
items.why_now: 港大教授新创公司获数亿融资，加速具身智能商业化落地。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong University professors founded TranscEngram, which recently secured hundreds of millions in angel investment from investors including China Zhongzheng Pharmaceutical and Pudong Venture Capital. The company develops an interpretable embodied intelligence system featuring a unified "brain-cerebellum" architecture that improves multi-task performance by over three times compared to traditional VLA models, achieving success rates exceeding 95%. Its commercial strategy focuses on high-end hotel services and flexible aerospace manufacturing through four proprietary products: EngramTeleOp, EngramEgo, EngramControl, and EngramNav.

items.title: 美团 LongCat-2.0 完全开源（MIT 许可），1.6T MoE 模型开放权重与推理代码
items.summary: 美团开源了采用 MIT 许可证的 LongCat-2.0 大模型，该模型基于 1.6T 参数的 MoE 架构，拥有约 48B 活跃参数及 1M token 上下文窗口。其核心技术包括 LongCat Sparse Attention 和 MOPD 门控路由机制，实现了与 Claude Code 等智能体的原生集成。在性能表现上，LongCat-2.0 在 SWE-bench Pro 等基准测试中超越 GPT-5.5，并在 OpenRouter 平台上作为 Owl Alpha 的底层模型提供服务。
items.why_now: 美团今日开源LongCat-2.0，1.6T MoE模型性能超越GPT-5.5，适合独立开发者。
items.summary_en: Meituan has fully open-sourced LongCat-2.0 under an MIT license, releasing weights and inference code for its 1.6T parameter MoE model with approximately 48B active parameters and a 1M token context window. The model features agent-native capabilities through specialized expert groups and efficient attention mechanisms, demonstrating superior performance over competitors like GPT-5.5 on benchmarks such as SWE-bench Pro (59.5 vs 58.6). It supports deployment on both GPU and NPU platforms and integrates directly with tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw.

items.title: LlamaIndex 发布 legal-kb：基于 Index v2 的智能体检索参考应用
items.summary: LlamaIndex 发布基于 Index v2 的法律文档知识库应用 legal-kb，底层采用 Vercel AI SDK 6 的 ToolLoopAgent 架构。该应用赋予 Agent retrieve、findFiles、readFile 和 grepFile 四项文件系统工具，通过先检索文件清单再精确定位内容的流程实现智能体检索。项目支持用户上传文件自动解析并管理版本，兼容 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 模型及自定义 API Key。
items.why_now: LlamaIndex于2026年7月5日发布legal-kb。
items.summary_en: LlamaIndex released legal-kb, an intelligent retrieval reference application for legal documents built on Index v2 and the LlamaParse Platform. The system utilizes a Retrieval Harness mode with four agent tools—retrieve, findFiles, readFile, and grepFile—to enable precise semantic search, file navigation, and regex-based content extraction within a TanStack Start web app.

items.title: Show HN: AI integrated in any terminal that's invisible until you need it
items.summary: 该开源终端应用通过透明包装 Shell，原生支持 Claude 和 Codex 等 AI Agent，并利用 MCP 协议自动获取终端内容及滚动记录以辅助输入建议。开发者手动实现了核心的事件处理及全屏 TUI 渲染逻辑，解决了 AI 难以处理的透明化难题，目前已在 macOS 和 Linux 环境下作为日常开发工具使用。
items.summary_en: The developer created an open-source terminal wrapper that integrates AI agents like Claude and Codex via MCP, allowing for transparent shell interaction and scrollback access. Key technical challenges involved manually implementing event handling and frame rendering to ensure the tool remains invisible until activated. Currently used as a daily driver on macOS and Linux, the alpha-quality software does not yet support Windows.

items.title: Show HN: Peek-CLI: Let Claude Code See the Browser
items.summary: Peek-CLI 是一款开源命令行工具，旨在让 Claude Code 能够“看到”浏览器界面。该工具通过截图和视觉分析技术，增强了 Claude Code 处理前端 UI 交互和调试的能力。它解决了传统代码模型无法直接感知网页视觉状态的局限，提升了自动化开发效率。

items.title: Show HN: A bedside camera detects REM sleep and agrees with a clinical EEG
items.summary: INSPEC设备通过床旁红外摄像头监测眼部像素方差来检测REM睡眠，利用面部追踪和运动过滤技术排除干扰。实验显示，其识别的REM时段与临床EEG及ezscore、DreamentoScorer等分类器的结果完全一致。该技术方案实现了非接触式睡眠监测，在长时程REM阶段匹配度上验证了其有效性。

items.title: Show HN: Sidenote – comment on your rendered blog, an LLM writes the Git diff
items.summary: Sidenote 是一款允许用户直接在渲染后的博客页面上进行注释的工具，其核心功能是利用大语言模型自动生成对应的 Git diff。该项目由 Bharadwaj Pendyala 开发并开源至 GitHub，旨在简化基于版本控制的文档协作流程。

items.title: Show HN: Open-source guided code reviews
items.summary: Plannotator Code Review 是一款开源工具，支持 Claude Code、Copilot 等主流平台，通过语义概览和分组差异自动汇总代码变更。其核心优势在于无需依赖高级模型推理能力，利用开源模型即可高效实现引导式代码审查。该工具兼容本地提交、PR 及 jj、p4 等版本控制系统，旨在构建自动化迭代反馈循环。
items.summary_en: Plannotator is an open-source tool that facilitates guided code reviews for local changes, pull requests, and version control systems like jj and p4 by surfacing important changes with semantic overviews. It supports integration with major AI providers such as Claude Code, Copilot, and Cursor, enabling automated iteration loops where agents submit feedback. The solution emphasizes efficiency by utilizing open-source models rather than relying on advanced reasoning capabilities.

items.title: Show HN: Make No Mistakes – AI coding agents must prove their work
items.summary: 该项目通过引入“形式化验证”机制，强制AI编程代理在生成代码后必须提供数学证明以验证其正确性，从而解决传统LLM编码易出错的问题。与常规代码补全方案不同，该方法显著提升了复杂逻辑和算法实现的可靠性，确保输出结果在形式上无错误。
items.summary_en: Make No Mistakes is an open-source project that enforces rigorous verification protocols for AI coding agents to eliminate errors. The tool implements a structured workflow where agents must prove their work through automated testing and validation before finalizing code changes. This approach enhances reliability in AI-assisted development by prioritizing correctness over speed.

items.title: Show HN: Nomlings – a virtual pet that eats your Claude Code session's tokens
items.summary: Nomlings是一款虚拟宠物应用，通过消耗Claude Code会话中的Token来互动。该工具将编程过程中的Token使用量转化为宠物喂养资源，提供了一种趣味化的代码编辑体验。
items.summary_en: Nomlings is a virtual pet tool that consumes tokens from Claude Code sessions, visually representing resource usage during coding tasks. The project is currently showcased on Hacker News with 6 points and 1 comment, available at nomlings.cc.

items.title: Show HN: Diffy – browser extension for faster GitHub PR review experience
items.summary: Diffy 是一款基于 TypeScript、React 和 WXT 构建的浏览器扩展，通过调用 GitHub API 提供全屏可滚动差异视图、侧边对比模式及 50+ 主题等核心功能。用户只需点击“View Diff”按钮或右键 PR 链接即可启动，支持公共仓库直接使用，私有仓库需配置 GitHub Token 以获取更高 API 速率限制及评论权限。该工具实现了无账号试用，并在 Chrome 和 Firefox 应用商店上架。
items.summary_en: Diffy is a browser extension for Chrome and Firefox that enhances GitHub pull request reviews by providing a full-screen, scrollable diff interface with features like a searchable file tree, side-by-side views, and over 50 themes. Built with TypeScript, React, and WXT, it allows users to instantly access diffs via a "View Diff" button or right-click context menu, utilizing the GitHub API for both public repositories and authenticated private ones.

items.title: immich-app/immich
items.summary: Immich 是一款高性能的自托管照片和视频管理解决方案，支持移动端和网页端。其核心能力包括基于 CLIP、面部识别及元数据的多维度搜索，以及 RAW 格式支持、LivePhoto 备份和离线访问等功能。
items.summary_en: Immich is a high-performance, self-hosted solution for managing photos and videos, offering robust features such as facial recognition, object search via CLIP, and support for raw formats and LivePhotos. The platform provides comprehensive mobile and web interfaces with capabilities like automatic background backups, multi-user support, and shared albums. It also includes administrative functions on the web side, such as OAuth support, API keys, and user management, ensuring a complete ecosystem for personal media storage.

items.title: 鄂尔多斯、和达金服共同领投，「贻如科技」完成超亿元A轮融资｜36氪首发
items.summary: 贻如科技完成超亿元A轮融资，由鄂尔多斯集团与和达金服领投，资金将用于推动商业化开拓、产能建设及依托AI技术加速生物基皮革研发。公司凭借微生物发酵技术实现碳排放降低80%以上，将成本压至真皮一半以下（80-200元/米），截至2026年第一季度年产能为1600万平方米，海外订单近亿元。目前贻如已与安踏、亚朵及欧洲奢侈品牌等达成合作，境外订单占比约三分之二，并计划于2026年筹备上市。

items.title: 硬氪首发 | 清华车辆学院师兄弟创业具身智能，已完成数亿元天使融资，将落地汽车产业
items.summary: 清华系具身智能公司「光象科技」完成累计数亿元天使轮融资，其核心技术为强调自主物理规律学习的“物理原生基座模型”，区别于主流VLA路线。公司已发布工业级机器人Phi-Bot X1，在汽车产线焊接上下料场景中实现21.5小时零失误运行，并在移动质检中将效率提升51%、部署周期压缩至周级。公司计划深耕汽车制造这一千亿级市场，利用该场景作为突破口，未来3至5年向更广泛的工业领域延伸。
items.summary_en: Tsinghua University spin-off Guangxiang Technology has secured hundreds of millions in angel funding to commercialize its physical-native embodied AI robots, starting with the industrial-grade Phi-Bot X1. The robot features 27 degrees of freedom and achieves 0.05mm repeatability, having demonstrated zero-error performance in automotive welding and material handling tasks. Backed by a proprietary "three-in-one" technical system comprising the Phi-RL Matrix algorithm and Phi-Space data assets, the company aims to address the 30% automation gap in China's 100-billion-yuan automotive robotics market.

items.title: 早报｜曝折叠屏iPhone发售将推迟/华为何庭波发布「韬定律」V2版论文/7-Eleven起诉耐克新鞋配色涉嫌抄袭
items.summary: 天风国际证券分析师郭明錤预测，苹果首款折叠屏iPhone（传闻命名iPhone Ultra）首发出货量约为700万至800万台，预计于第四季度正式开售。受三星DRAM拟开启今年第三轮大幅提价及苹果官方调价影响，内存和SSD等零部件成本持续飙升，导致手机、电脑等终端产品面临涨价压力，经销商建议非刚需消费者暂缓购买。
items.summary_en: Tianfeng International analyst Guo Mingchi predicts Apple’s first foldable iPhone will launch in Q4 with initial shipments of 500,000 to 1 million units, potentially commanding a 50–100% premium on the secondary market due to manufacturing constraints. Concurrently, Samsung plans a third round of DRAM price hikes targeting up to 20% in Q3, driven by supply bottlenecks that are already forcing Apple and Lenovo to raise end-product prices. Meanwhile, Anthropic is reportedly negotiating with Samsung to develop custom AI chips using 2-nanometer processes, while Huawei’s He Tingbo released the V2 version of its "Tao Law" paper detailing post-Moore scaling architectures and performance metrics for upcoming Kirin and Ascend products.

items.title: Is anyone else building an AI native service business?
items.summary: 作者正利用Cursor构建内部系统以打造AI原生网页代理，目前拥有5名客户并产生数千欧元收入。该模式通过自动化爬虫筛选潜在客户、智能审核网站质量及搭建客户端门户来实现运营提效，旨在让单人团队具备小型公司的运作能力。
items.summary_en: The author is building an AI-native web agency with five clients and modest revenue, utilizing automated systems for lead scraping via Google Maps and autonomous website deployment through a custom Cursor-based "company brain." While humans handle sales and strategy, AI agents manage research, project management, and routine updates, enabling a single operator to function like a small team. The workflow integrates a client portal for approvals and payments, aiming to replace traditional manual processes with scalable automation.

items.title: Show HN: Video Effects SDK – Face Avatars
items.summary: 该视频特效SDK利用MediaPipe的GPU（WebGL2）或WASM CPU代理在Web Worker中实时追踪人脸，并在用户面部渲染基于ARKit Facial Blendshapes标准的GLB格式3D头像模型。
items.summary_en: The Video Effects SDK renders a 3D face avatar onto users by leveraging MediaPipe’s GPU delegate (WebGL2) with an automatic fallback to a WASM CPU delegate. It operates via a dedicated Web Worker that dynamically imports MediaPipe, the WASM runtime, and the 3D model, supporting only one face at a time. The system requires the avatar asset to be a GLB file containing Apple ARKit Facial Blendshapes.

items.title: 8点1氪丨7-11指控耐克新鞋配色抄袭；A股新版交易规则今起施行；华尔街称苹果采购长鑫内存是为了压价
items.summary: 7-11在美国起诉耐克，指控其7月11日发售的Air Max 95运动鞋配色抄袭品牌标志性三色设计。A股新版交易规则于7月6日施行，涵盖盘后固定价格交易扩容至全A股、ST板块涨跌幅调整为10%及创业板引入做市商制度等五大变化。苹果拟于秋季上线仅限iPhone 15 Pro及以上机型的Siri AI，华尔街分析认为其采购长鑫内存旨在通过谈判筹码压低三星、海力士和美光的供货价格。
items.summary_en: Apple plans to launch an upgraded Siri AI this fall, restricted to iPhone 15 Pro models and newer devices equipped with A17 Pro chips or higher. Meanwhile, Wall Street analysts suggest Apple’s rumored procurement of memory from China’s CXMT is primarily a negotiation tactic to pressure major suppliers like Samsung and SK Hynix into lowering prices.

directions.name: SkillForge CLI
directions.description: 一个基于现有开源技能库的封装工具，允许开发者一键将特定领域的“技能包”集成到任何AI编码代理中，实现垂直领域知识的即时注入。
directions.description_en: A wrapper tool based on existing open-source skill libraries that allows developers to instantly inject domain-specific 'skill packs' into any AI coding agent with one command.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者、一人公司技术创始人、AI应用构建者
directions.target_user_en: Indie hackers, solo founders, AI application builders
core_features: 一键导入与配置354+预训练技能包
跨平台兼容层（支持Claude, OpenAI, Gemini等）
技能包市场与用户自定义分享功能
core_features_en: One-click import and configuration of 354+ pre-trained skill packs
Cross-platform compatibility layer (supports Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, etc.)
Skill pack marketplace and user-defined sharing features
directions.why_now: GitHub上alirezarezvani/claude-skills项目迅速获得5,200+星标，证明社区对现成、垂直领域AI技能包的巨大需求。当前AI编码工具碎片化严重，开发者急需一种标准化的方式来复用这些高价值的指令集，以降低上下文工程的门槛并提升编码效率。
directions.why_now_en: The alirezarezvani/claude-skills project on GitHub has rapidly gained over 5,200 stars, demonstrating a massive community demand for ready-made, vertical-domain AI skill packs. With current AI coding tools being fragmented, developers urgently need a standardized way to reuse these high-value instruction sets to lower the barrier of context engineering and improve coding efficiency.
directions.monetization: Freemium模式：基础技能包免费，高级垂直领域包（如法律、医疗合规）订阅制收费；企业版支持私有技能库托管。
directions.monetization_en: Freemium model: Basic skill packs are free, advanced vertical domain packs (e.g., legal, healthcare compliance) are subscription-based; Enterprise version supports private skill pack hosting.

directions.name: SQLite-Audit Guard
directions.description: 专为单人开发者设计的SQLite自动事务安全中间件，通过拦截写入操作并强制校验commit状态，防止因AI辅助编程产生的未提交数据丢失Bug。
directions.description_en: An automatic transaction safety middleware designed for solo developers, intercepting write operations and forcing commit status verification to prevent data loss bugs caused by AI-assisted programming.
directions.target_user: 使用AI辅助编程的独立开发者、小型SaaS创始人
directions.target_user_en: Solo developers using AI-assisted programming, small SaaS founders
core_features: 自动检测未提交的写入操作并警告
模拟Simon Willison案例中的常见AI编程陷阱
轻量级插件式集成，无需重构原有代码库
core_features_en: Automatically detect uncommitted write operations and warn
Simulate common AI programming pitfalls like those in Simon Willison's case
Lightweight plugin-style integration without refactoring existing codebases
directions.why_now: Simon Willison的博客显示其sqlite-utils 4.0rc2由Claude Fable协助开发，成本仅$149.25但暴露了严重的自动事务提交Bug。这揭示了AI生成代码在边缘情况处理上的不可靠性。随着越来越多的一人公司依赖AI生成核心数据逻辑，针对AI代码缺陷的安全网工具将成为刚需。
directions.why_now_en: Simon Willison's blog revealed that sqlite-utils 4.0rc2 was assisted by Claude Fable for only $149.25 but exposed severe bugs with automatic transaction commits. This highlights the unreliability of AI-generated code in edge cases. As more solo companies rely on AI to generate core data logic, safety nets for AI code defects will become a must-have.
directions.monetization: 一次性购买授权费或低月费SaaS插件服务，面向个人开发者定价亲民。
directions.monetization_en: One-time purchase license fee or low monthly SaaS plugin service, priced affordably for individual developers.
directions.source_article: sqlite-utils 4.0rc2, mostly written by Claude Fable (for about $149.25)
